================================================================================
Immediate suffix works after its numeric prefix
================================================================================
0lf
---
(program (number (digits) (suffix)))

================================================================================
Bare suffix spelling remains an identifier
================================================================================
lf
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Suffix spelling does not steal a definition name
================================================================================
let lf = value
---
(program (definition (word) (word)))

================================================================================
Ordinary keyword works alongside the immediate suffix
================================================================================
0in foo
---
(program (number (digits) (word)))

================================================================================
Demoted suffix does not manufacture an unsafe keyword conflict
:error
================================================================================
0infoo
---
(program (ERROR (digits)) (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace prevents an immediate suffix
:error
================================================================================
0 lf
---
(program (ERROR (digits)) (word))
